title: Eisenhower Matrix Explained: Urgent vs Important, Its Real Origin and Indian Examples
seoTitle: Eisenhower Matrix: Urgent vs Important, Explained
seoDescription: The Eisenhower matrix sorts tasks by urgency and importance: do, schedule, delegate or drop. See its real origin, the research and Indian examples.
